The organization is read in each of its versions: from 2026-04-01 and 2027-04-01.

## Positions and kinds of team

- Positions, from the lowest: Staff (`staff`), Manager (`manager`), Head of department (`dept_head`), Head of division (`division_head`), President (`president`).
- Kinds of team, from the widest: Company (`company`), Division (`division`), Department (`department`), Section (`section`), Committee (`committee`).
